description: This file defines the interface for managing a security daemon within a wireless LAN management system. It includes type definitions, function prototypes for initialization, control, configuration, event handling, and status queries related to the security daemon. The file also declares external handlers for various daemon events and manages security parameters and commands support.

classes.name: wld_secDmn
classes.description: Represents the security daemon with control mechanisms, configuration, event handling, and group management attributes.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_init
methods.description: Initializes a new security daemon instance with command, arguments, configuration file, and control interface directory.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets the event handlers for various security daemon events such as restart, stop, start, and configuration.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with the security daemon instance.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_start
methods.description: Starts the security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_stop
methods.description: Stops the running security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_reload
methods.description: Reloads the security daemon configuration.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setArgs
methods.description: Sets startup arguments for the security daemon.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_restart
methods.description: Restarts the security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setRestartNeeded
methods.description: Flags the daemon to need a restart.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_checkRestartNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether the daemon needs a restart.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isRestarting
methods.description: Returns whether the daemon is currently restarting.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is currently running.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is enabled.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is alive.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasAvailableCtrlIface
methods.description: Verifies if a control interface is available.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Verifies if a global control interface is present.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasReadyGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Checks if a ready global control interface is available.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Retrieves the global control interface.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getWpaCtrlMgr
methods.description: Gets the WPA control manager associated with the daemon.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setCfgParamSupp
methods.description: Sets support status for configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCfgParamSupp
methods.description: Retrieves support status for specific configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCfgParamsListBySuppVal
methods.description: Lists configuration parameters supported by a certain value.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppAll
methods.description: Counts all supported configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppChecked
methods.description: Counts checked configuration parameters support.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppByVal
methods.description: Counts configuration parameters supported by a specific value.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_detectCfgParamsSupp
methods.description: Detects support for given configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCtrlIfaceDirPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the control interface directory.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setCmdSupp
methods.description: Sets support status for specific commands.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCmdSupp
methods.description: Gets support status for specific commands.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_learnCmdSuppFromHelpMsg
methods.description: Infers command support from help message outputs.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_deduceCmdSuppFromExecRc
methods.description: Infers command support based on command execution return code.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_addToGrp
methods.description: Adds the security daemon to a group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_delFromGrp
methods.description: Removes the security daemon from its group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getGrp
methods.description: Retrieves the group to which the daemon belongs.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isGrpMember
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is a member of a group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countGrpMembers
methods.description: Counts total group members.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countActiveGrpMembers
methods.description: Counts active group members.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isActiveAlone
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is active alone in group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isGrpRestarting
methods.description: Checks if the group's daemon process is restarting.
